title: Amazing experience!
text: I had a private tour with Cristina. She was really nice and made the experience very enjoyable. It was a lovely way to explore the city. Definitely recommend it!
author: susanalB6950TL

title: Beautiful bike experience with sylvio
text:
Sylvio is a very interesting guide and shares his passion for his city through history and anecdotes.
Very thoughtful and attentive to his group
author: O6488WEvivianel

title: We recommend
text: We loved visiting Seville by bike. It was a first for us. The city is equipped with bike paths, which allows for safe exploration. Our guide, who is also one of the founders, is passionate about history and very attentive to clients. Since we knew some places, he adapted the route to help us discover other locations.
author: 863catherinet

title: Discover Seville by bike
text: A top-notch guided bike tour of Seville! Our guide Silvio spoke excellent French and shared his love for his city with us! A very comprehensive tour of Seville! Do it without hesitation!
author: palounoel

title: Great quality and friendly bike tour
text: A great time in the company of Sylvio. Very warm welcome, we were even upgraded to an electric bike for free. Very good explanations of the history of Seville and the main monuments. Small group and a very friendly and high-quality exchange with Sylvio. We left with a small backpack as a gift and plenty of recommendations for other things to visit as well as all the good typical things to drink and eat in Seville.
author: G2660IZclairec

title: Pedaolé guided bike tour of Seville
text: A superb way to discover Seville as a family as soon as we arrived! With Sylvio, a young Sevillian with perfect French, we traveled through the main neighborhoods and discovered the history and must-see sights of Seville. The tour was very informative and pleasant, and we felt safe throughout the route on the bike paths. The bikes, new and comfortable, also helped make this experience even more pleasant. Many recommendations at the end of the tour to extend the experience like a local. We highly recommend this activity!
author: sophien262

title: Superb ride.
text: We will have excellent memories of this guided electric bike ride. Very high-quality equipment and an exceptional, friendly guide who speaks perfect French.
author: 425sybillep

title: Superb
text: Great bike ride with friends in Seville with an extraordinary guide who knew how to share the riches of his city with us. Very attentive, he gave us excellent addresses for eating or having a drink.
author: girodetl

title: Very beautiful experience.
text: A very beautiful experience… small group so no waiting in traffic, very high-quality bikes, numerous explanations that were very pleasant to listen to.
author: B5746WMbrigitter

title: Magnificent private tour
text: Such a unique experience, choosing the private option was definitely a game changer. Silvio was our guide and he was extremely knowledgeable about the city. The tour was at a quiet pace and he also gave us restaurants to eat at like real locals!
